description: This Java source file defines the ContactMechServices class, which provides a set of service methods for creating, updating, deleting, and managing contact mechanisms (such as addresses, phone numbers, and emails) within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes functions for handling different contact mechanism types, verifying permissions, copying contact data, and generating verification tokens.

classes.name: ContactMechServices
classes.description: Provides static service methods for managing contact mechanisms such as addresses, phone numbers, and emails in OFBiz.

methods.name: createContactMech
methods.description: Creates a new contact mechanism and associates it with a party if provided, with security checks and type restrictions.

methods.name: updateContactMech
methods.description: Updates an existing contact mechanism by creating a new version with changes, managing related party contact info, with security checks.

methods.name: deleteContactMech
methods.description: Marks a contact mechanism as inactive by setting its 'thruDate', effectively deleting it.

methods.name: createPostalAddress
methods.description: Creates a postal address contact mechanism and links it to a party.

methods.name: updatePostalAddress
methods.description: Updates a postal address contact mechanism, creating a new version and maintaining links.

methods.name: createTelecomNumber
methods.description: Creates a telecom number contact mechanism and links it to a party.

methods.name: updateTelecomNumber
methods.description: Updates a telecom number contact mechanism with versioning and link management.

methods.name: createEmailAddress
methods.description: Creates an email address contact mechanism by wrapping createContactMech with type-specific info.

methods.name: updateEmailAddress
methods.description: Updates an email address contact mechanism by wrapping updateContactMech with type-specific info.

methods.name: createPartyContactMechPurpose
methods.description: Creates a purpose association for a party contact mechanism, with date management and validation.

methods.name: getPartyContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves all contact mechanisms for a party, optionally including old or expired ones.

methods.name: copyPartyContactMechs
methods.description: Copies contact mechanisms and their purposes from one party to another without deletion.

methods.name: createEmailAddressVerification
methods.description: Generates a verification hash for an email address and records it with an expiration, for email verification.
